content.text: {"number": 482, "title": "feat(rpc): retry with backoff on timeout", "state": "open", "body": "Retries timed-out RPC calls up to 3 times with exponential backoff, shortens the default timeout to 5 s and adds RpcError::Exhausted.\n\nCloses #470."}
